Use synthetic or expressly authorized anonymized examples. Do not include passports, microchip IDs, addresses, phone numbers, bookings or secrets.
仅用合成或明确授权的匿名案例，不贴护照、芯片号、地址、电话、订单及密钥。

- Who has this problem and in what situation / 谁在何种场景遇到问题:
- Current workaround and limitation / 当前替代及限制:
- Proposed behavior and example / 建议行为与示例:
- How success can be checked / 如何验收:
- Scope, official data needs and maintenance cost / 范围、官方数据需求与维护成本:
- Affiliation, if any / 关联关系:
